description: Land Title Settlement Department - Podape, Aranayaka  D/S/Division Kegalle District - Cad. Map No.610411 (24/0559)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to specific land parcels (Plot Nos. 1:1, 1:2 and 1:3) in Podape village, including detailed land particulars such as parcel numbers, extent, ownership (The State), and classification. The content focuses entirely on land administration and property rights, fitting squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
